calibration.method: One shared sheet body reference transferred from the fixed first-sheet neutral by reviewed median head/body width; never per-pose bbox height fitting
calibration.notes: Limbless whole compact body has no separate head. Independent reviewer measured neutral anatomy384 high. Calibrate each sheet once using whole body width median342.5/341/358/341.5, not each posture bbox high or imaginary feet.

frames.support_notes: Hamster has no limbs; actual lower body contact is the support, no imaginary feet. Native lower anatomical contact band observed at the bottom of the connected body drawing; its full band midpoint is retained separately from a full alpha bbox center. Main body only excludes disconnected texture specks for measurement; source pixels remain unchanged.
